steps.description:
Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Created a variable named dice and assign it a random number from 0 to 6

2. Display the dice variable value on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:
1. Display "Press to Roll The Dice" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When Button is pressed, perform the following:
- Created a variable named dice and assign a random number from 1 to 6
- Display the dice value on the LCD screen for 2 seconds with the following format:

Move # Steps

Example 1:
If 5 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 5 Steps

Example 2:
If 2 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 2 Steps

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:

1. Display "Press to Roll The Dice" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When Button is pressed, the dice robot will display different messages on the LCD Screen

Depending on the numerical value shown on the dice,
- Created a variable named dice and assign a random number from 0 to 6
- If 0 is rolled, display "Too Bad, Try Again" on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds
- If other numbers are rolled, display the dice value on the LCD screen for 2 seconds with the following format:

Move # Steps

Example 1:
If 5 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 5 Steps

Example 2:
If 2 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 2 Steps

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.

Show that your robot can perform the following:

1. Display "Press to Roll The Dice" until Button is pressed and then released

2. When Button is pressed,
- the dice robot will display different messages on the LCD Screen

Depending on the numerical value shown on the dice,
- If 0 is rolled, display "Too Bad, Try Again" on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds
- If other numbers are rolled, display the dice value on the LCD screen for 2 seconds with the following format:

Move # Steps

Example 1:
If 5 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 5 Steps

Example 2:
If 2 is rolled, the LCD screen will display the following text.

Move 2 Steps
- Display the previous rolled dice value on the LCD Screen

Example 1:
Roll          Dice    Display Message
1st roll       3         No Previous

If this is the first time you are rolling dice, display "No previous" on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

Example 2:
Roll          Dice    Display Message
1st roll       3         No Previous
2nd roll      2         The last roll is 3

If the previous dice value is 3, display "The last roll is 3" on the LCD Screen for 2 seconds

Example 3:
Roll          Dice    Display Message
1st roll       3         No Previous
2nd roll      2         The last roll is 3
3rd roll       0         The last roll is 2
4th roll       1         The last roll is 0
5th roll       1         The last roll is 1
6th roll       1         The last roll is 1
7th roll       1         The last roll is 1

The program should run forever and can only be terminated when the Stop Button on the blockly interface is clicked.
